procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio assessment in this session, with no agents, forks, resumes, peer reviews or image generation/editing. Read the exact packet, case, rubric, rules, compact method/addendum and adapter; verified the listed pins. The packet supplies zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so there were zero source opens and zero protected-layout reads. Read all five pinned native-evidence source_manifest files before poster viewing, without following their unlisted embedded paths. Actually opened and visually inspected the exact image files using tools.view_image with detail original, forwarding each returned image via image(): M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen opens completed before the first raw copy-reading/transcription stage or any judgment/score. First readings were then retained from those displayed pixels. One explained ambiguity about M2 time spacing triggered one further open of its exact pinned native image; total actual poster opens were sixteen, with fifteen initial ordered views and one revisit. No other revisits occurred. Byte/hash checks and PNG-header inspection were separate from viewing and were not treated as successful opens. All native PNGs are opaque RGB 1672x941; usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180. The 16:9 ratio passes the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge policy because abs(941 - 1672*9/16)=0.5; native ratios are rounded, not mathematically exact. No session ID is observable or asserted.

image_material.observation: Dense wandering embossed-looking grooves cover most cloth surfaces, including broad areas that would otherwise clarify fabric and panel construction. The repeated high-frequency relief gives the objects a noisy, overprocessed finish at close inspection.

image_material.location: red pouch zipper at its upper-right corner
image_material.observation: The long pale rounded pull/tab is less crisply resolved than the zipper teeth and fabric seam; combined with the surface noise, the material finish is below the strong professional threshold.
The shapes and matching colors work at usage scale, but reduction conceals the close-up surface/edge weaknesses rather than resolving them.

The gesture communicates welcoming participation without an exaggerated character scene.

ai_slop.observation: Similar small irregular grooves repeat across the shirt and both differently colored pouches, with little relation to panel boundaries or cloth grain. This pervasive surface noise is an observable finish defect rather than a medium-based objection.
The pale elongated rounded tab is locally vague in construction and adds to the unresolved generated-looking detail.

residuals: The pervasive embossed/squiggly textile texture and vague red-pouch zipper tab remain below 4 in image_material and ai_slop.
Sharing is communicated by paired offered pouches, less explicitly than the exchange arrows or the joint human handoff in other members.
The vivid crop/card composition is distinct, but its heavy sans typography and matching-stripe pouch motif recur elsewhere in the set.

space.observation: The forearm ends abruptly on a diagonal in the blank interior, while the opposite arm enters from the right edge. The asymmetric clipping leaves the left offering gesture spatially unanchored.

The large masthead/title zones are organized, but the interior-cut forearm and crowded shirt/pouch overlap give the image grouping a pasted-in balance rather than a fully resolved relationship to the page.

image_material.location: shirt stripes, pouch seams and zipper contours

image_material.observation: Both finished-object silhouettes and palms survive reduction clearly, without needing tiny texture to identify the content.

emotion_control.location: cream/black type with orange and blue object accents
emotion_control.observation: The energetic print-like treatment makes the event feel active and accessible while leaving adult participation information clear.

emotion_control.location: paired offering gestures and reassurance line
emotion_control.observation: The finished objects are presented invitingly rather than dramatically; the readable reassurance supports newcomers.

ai_slop.observation: The detached truncated forearm is a concrete unresolved construction/framing detail, unlike the right arm's edge crop. It weakens the paired exchange as a unified scene.
The stacked cutout objects and unmatched arm origins leave a generic assembled-clipart impression at close inspection despite otherwise coherent linework.

residuals: The left forearm's abrupt interior cutoff and its mismatch with the edge-entering right arm remain below 4 in space and ai_slop.
The matching-fabric and two offered-pouch motif repeats M1/M2/M3, though the masthead-led composition changes its role and scale.

evidence.location: whole split composition
evidence.observation: Warm close tabletop photography and a simultaneous foreground handoff sit beneath a left title, with an independent right information panel. Unlike the others, the practical-reading path is a full-height side column.

evidence.location: date/title split, center sequence and footer
evidence.observation: A date-first left heading and right title lead to a horizontal shirt-to-pouch arrow and explicit exchange loop, followed by a ruled three-column footer. This changes the image's role from scene/product to explanatory sequence rather than merely changing material or color.

evidence.location: diagonal garment crop, central band and opposite cards
evidence.observation: A very large upper-right product crop intersects a stepped cream title field over blue; offered pouches are at lower left and details sit in opposite corner cards. It shares fabric/product motifs with M1, but uses crop, overlap, card placement and saturated field instead of a full-height split panel.

evidence.location: people above diagonal table and shirt below
evidence.observation: An illustrated social handoff, full adult faces and an oblique tabletop create a narrative viewpoint. The source garment lies in the foreground and practical copy fills quiet areas of the table. This changes emotion, scene action and information integration from all four object/diagram-led systems.

evidence.location: English masthead, Korean title left and object group right
evidence.observation: An oversized English masthead leads a strongly typographic composition, with the smaller garment/paired-pouch illustration grouped at right and two lower detail zones. Its image/type scale relationship differs from M2's wide causal diagram and from M3's dominant shirt crop.

evidence.location: relationship across the five members
evidence.observation: All five repeatedly use heavy sans Korean, uppercase English and matching fabric/finished pouches. These recurrences limit exceptional diversity, but the side-panel photograph, explanatory sequence, overlapping product/card composition, narrative table scene and masthead-led graphic are substantially different complete arrangements.

residuals: Heavy sans typography and matched garment/pouch motifs recur across the set, so diversity is strong rather than exceptional.
M1 and M3 both use realistic hand/product imagery, and M2 and M5 both use isolated drawn garment/pouch motifs; distinct crop, composition and information roles carry their separation.
The count/diversity judgment does not cancel M2's definite copy/style failure or M3/M5's low dimensional scores.
